sources.title: Obituary of Alphonse J. Vigliotti Sr., Find a Grave memorial 63661294
sources.repository: The Journal News, 3 January 2011, as transcribed on Find a Grave
sources.note: Born 14 March 1921 in Eastchester, NY, to the late Vincent and Vencenza Guido Vigliotti. Died 1 January 2011 at Dobbs Ferry Hospital, aged 89. World War II veteran, United States Army. Manager for A&P in Eastchester. Member of the Eastchester Volunteer Fire Department. Survived by wife Concetta Mignone Vigliotti, son Alphonse (Barbara) J. Vigliotti Jr., daughters Susan (Pat) Fucale and Renee (George) Makras, seven grandchildren including Ehren and Dylan, sisters Angelina Zaino, Virginia Waddell, Louise and Sylvia Vigliotti, and brother Andrew Vigliotti. Predeceased by sister Madeline Woodruff and brothers Anthony and Vincent Vigliotti. Funeral at Immaculate Heart of Mary, Scarsdale. Interment at Gate of Heaven Cemetery.

sources.note: Death on 24 April 1944 at Mount Pleasant, New York, certificate 26490, surname indexed as VIGHIOTTO. Combined with the Scarsdale Inquirer notice, this is treated as Vincent Vigliotti of 44 Brambach Road.

sources.title: Four Sons in the Service
sources.repository: Scarsdale Inquirer, 4 December 1942
sources.note: The Vigliottis of 40 Brambach Road (later notices and the census say 44) had four sons in the armed forces: Alphonse and Andrew in the Army, Vincent and Tony in the Navy. The photo caption calls the father James. It notes two sets of twins, Tony and Andrew aged twenty, Virginia and Sylvia aged sixteen, and a recent twenty-fifth wedding anniversary.

sources.title: V. J. Vigliotti Dies, Funeral This Morning
sources.repository: Scarsdale Inquirer, 28 April 1944
sources.note: Vincent J. Vigliotti of 44 Brambach Road died on Monday in Grasslands Hospital after a long illness. Born in Italy fifty-three years ago. Survived by wife Vincenza Guida Vigliotti, four sons in the armed forces (Alphonse, Anthony, Andrew and Vincent, Jr.), and five daughters (Madeline, Virginia, Sylvia, Angelina and Louise). Funeral at Immaculate Heart of Mary.

sources.title: Concetta Mignone Is Future Bride
sources.repository: Scarsdale Inquirer, 4 April 1947
sources.note: Engagement of Concetta Mignone, daughter of Mr. and Mrs. Gerard Mignone, and Alphonse J. Vigliotti, son of Mrs. Vincent Vigliotti.

sources.title: Concetta Mignone Bride This Week
sources.repository: Scarsdale Inquirer, 29 August 1947
sources.note: Marriage of Concetta Mignone, daughter of Mr. and Mrs. Gerard Mignone of 151 Brook Street, and Alphonse Vigliotti, son of Mrs. Vinnie Vigliotti of 44 Brambach Road, on 24 August 1947 at the Church of the Immaculate Heart of Mary. Andrew was best man; Anthony and Angelina also took part. Both were graduates of Eastchester High School. Alphonse was an Army veteran of the European area, then employed by the Tommasi Motor Company.

sources.title: Gerard Mignone Dies Eastchester Resident
sources.repository: Scarsdale Inquirer, 8 November 1957
sources.note: Gerard Mignone of 92 Dunwoodie St., a carpenter, died on 29 October at White Plains Hospital, aged 58. A native of Italy. Survived by his wife, Mrs. Susan Rescigno Mignone; two daughters, Mrs. Alphonse J. Vigliotti and Miss Joanne Mignone; and six sons, Francis, Edward, Rudolph, Peter, Lawrence, and Gerard Mignone, all of Eastchester.

sources.title: Resident's Mother Dies
sources.repository: Scarsdale Inquirer, 17 June 1949
sources.note: Mrs. Augusta R. Ehrenfels of Mt. Vernon, mother of Mrs. James Morrissey of 31 Downer Ave., died on 8 June at the Lawrence Hospital in Bronxville after a short illness. Funeral at Immaculate Heart of Mary. Also leaves another daughter, Mrs. Daniel Barrett. A New York State death index transcription gives 6 April 1949, which conflicts with this notice; the newspaper date is used until the index image is read.

sources.title: Ancestry member tree KINDRED SPIRITS (tree 65434896)
sources.repository: Ancestry, tree owner TerryCoe51
sources.note: Secondary compiled tree. Gives Vincenzo Vigliotti born 4 July 1885 at Santa Maria a Vico, Caserta, son of Andrea Vigliotti and Mariantonia Ruotolo, died 24 April 1944 at Mount Pleasant; Vincenza Pasqualina Guida born 21 September 1899 at Arienzo, Caserta, daughter of Alfonso Guida and Antonia Vigliotti, died November 1984 at Scarsdale; marriage 31 July 1916; Alphonse Sr married Concetta Mignone (1927 to 2012) on 24 August 1947 at Eastchester; and exact birth and death dates for several of their children. Every claim from this tree is a lead until a record is seen.

sources.note: Born 1837, Ardmore, Ireland; came to the United States as a boy; settled in Yonkers about 1853; carpenter and builder; Water Commissioner; leader in the St Vincent de Paul Society; died 9 July 1916 at 117 Palisade Avenue, Yonkers. Married Ellen E. Kelly. Sons include William A., a lawyer. The birthplace phrase is highlighted on a saved copy; the full text is in the saved HTML.

sources.title: Find a Grave memorial 197940245, Catherine Jane Cleary Hingston, with Herald Statesman obituary, 1 September 1932
sources.repository: The Herald Statesman, Yonkers, 1 September 1932, as transcribed on Find a Grave
sources.note: Born 1845, Huntingdon, Canada, daughter of Owen Cleary and Catherine Donohue; married Samuel J. Hingston in 1872 in Huntingdon; died 31 August 1932 at the Walsh home, 51 Park Avenue, Yonkers. Samuel had died about 1928, aged about 85. Daughters include Clara (Mrs William A. Walsh). The cousinship to Sir William Hingston of Montreal is a family story in this notice, not yet proven.
